# Hannah Keeps Her Promise (1 Samuel 1:28)

## Emotional Focus
Keeping our promises to God when He answers.

## Key KJV
“I have lent him to the LORD.” (1 Samuel 1:28)

## Gentle Retelling
Hannah prayed for a baby and promised to give him to God. When Samuel was born, she kept her promise and brought him to the temple. God blessed her obedience.

## Coloring Prompt
Hannah happily bringing young Samuel to the temple with a peaceful smile.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“Keeping our promises to God brings blessing.”
